description: This file defines the SignatureInterface interface within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifying methods for signing requests and creating pre-signed URLs used in AWS authentication protocols.

classes.name: SignatureInterface
classes.description: An interface outlining methods for signing AWS requests and generating pre-signed URLs, enabling different signature protocols within the AWS SDK for PHP.

methods.name: signRequest
methods.description: Signs an HTTP request with AWS signing protocol using provided credentials, adding necessary authorization headers.

methods.name: presign
methods.description: Creates a pre-signed request/URL that expires after a specified duration, allowing temporary access to AWS resources.
